shared_elements: upright carved stone monument bearing a human/anthropomorphic figure
frontal standing/seated anthropomorphic figure with head and limbs indicated
justification: Both show an upright block-like monument carrying an anthropomorphic figure rendered frontally with a large head and compact limbs, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A depicts a flat slab with a shallow, largely effaced relief set within a stepped architectural setting, while B is a fully three-dimensional crouching figure with a distinct headdress and a second carved block above it, so the relationships and arrangement of depicted elements do not correspond.
